Description: YouGov survey of 1,082 US adults (June 2023) built to study measurement error in ranking questions: 18 ranking tasks of 3 to 6 options each, every response a full permutation (anchor questions with meaningless 'Blank' items and one with a known correct order, substantive questions on government roles, identity, holidays, affective polarisation and electoral systems, two wording arms, and four repeated questions; randomised halves saw 8 of the 18). One row per respondent x task x option; item = option text (no option is a person), resp = position; trial_question = the question stem; covariates age band, gender, race, education, party ID. 12 estemporal responses with a repeated position dropped. Rankings layout (irw_rank family, data/rankings/README.md).
